stale_ptv_ids.title: PTV changed timetable IDs for {route_name}
stale_ptv_ids.description:
Departures for {route_name} keep coming back empty because PTV renumbered its timetable IDs.

Route {old_route_id} -> {new_route_id}, direction {old_direction_id} -> {new_direction_id}, stop {old_stop_id} -> {new_stop_id} (GTFS {route_gtfs_id}).

Detected: {detail}

Select **Submit** to update the IDs and reload the entry. Only the numeric IDs change - your entity names stay exactly the same.
